work.one_sum: W_total = S*c_stress + trap_charge(rate*cap*price) + sum(aux rows) + aux_reserve; claim = least 4-dp log2 >= log2(W_total) + 2e-5

aux.covers: the claim is taken from the SUM, not from W_stress: v23 took it from log2(W_stress) alone and the reviewer added the parts by hand

structural_kill.family: consecutive multiply steps on ONE row with kappa(y')=kappa(y)+6 use columns k and k+6, and TBL[t][k+6] = TBL[t][k]^-1, so y returns EXACTLY
structural_kill.fix: classkey.step_v24: when the drawn row repeats the previous multiply row the row is remapped to t XOR (1 + h mod (R-1)), a bijection onto the other R-1 rows, so two consecutive multiply steps NEVER share a row
structural_kill.marginal: row marginal stays exactly uniform; pair law is uniform on ordered pairs of distinct rows; statistical distance from iid uniform <= 1/R per step
structural_kill.cost: ROWDIFF = 16 instructions on the multiply channel, charged on every multiply step (constants.ROWDIFF): +0.00097 bits on W_stress, disclosed

success.trap_bound_production: P(class repeat within t steps) <= t(t-1)/2N, a union bound over pairs with no fixture input: t = cap = 128*2^80, N = 2^371 gives <= 2^-198; over the report interval theta^2/2N = 2^-92.3, the row charged
success.jensen: E[1-exp(-tau^2/2N)] with tau geometric(theta) is NOT 1-exp(-E[tau]^2/2N); the shipped row uses tau >= 1 (the smallest value) so the bound is taken at the p10-quantile direction, i.e. E[1-exp(-tau^2/2N)] >= 1-exp(-1/2N) and the birthday count uses S^2(1-f^2) directly rather than a mean tau

unconditional_census.seeds: random.Random(20261024 + 1000*worker); starts drawn from THAT stream
unconditional_census.reading: ONE product from the SAME runs: P(both reach a DP) x P(same DP class | both) x P(the twelve-shift solve verifies | same class).  No conditioning on a DP having been reached is applied to the numerator.

census_integrity.experiment_header_vs_code: cap 256 vs scheduled 264 in v23; v24 reports the ACTUAL trial count of every census (this file) and never a header

storage.overflow_policy: drop-oldest + drain, charged in ledger.aux:report_cap_drain; capacity is the CAP, so no run exceeds it
